note.title: Variation and mutation
note.overview: Variation may be genetic, environmental or both. Mutation creates new alleles through random DNA change.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for variation and mutation.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: Blood group is genetic; scars and language are environmental; height and body mass involve both genes and environment.
Mutations may be beneficial, neutral or harmful depending on context.
Body-cell mutations are not normally inherited; mutations in gamete-producing cells can be inherited.
